liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jam** (3 reviews): The wild jam leading into The Other One is singled out as unique and maniacal; Intense jam follows the Cryptical drums before returning to The Other One [4][9][10]
- **It's a Man's, Man's Man's World** (1 review): Reviewer calls this version stellar [5]
- **Candyman** (1 review): Reviewer's favorite Candyman ever, with very clear notes from Garcia [13]
- **Drums** (1 review): Reviewer calls the drums among the best they have heard [14]
- **That's It for the Other One** (1 review): Reviewer finds this section hot, continuing through Dire Wolf [14]
- **Dire Wolf** (1 review): Very tight segue from Cryptical Envelopment into Dire Wolf [9]
- **Turn On Your Lovelight** (1 review): The band sounds like they enjoy themselves playing Lovelight [5]

## Setlist highlights

- **It's a Man's, Man's Man's World**: rare: 8 archived performances [16]

## The recordings

- **gd70-04-15.sbd.kaplan.14354.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 17 songs; 96 min; rated 4.79/5 by 62 [1]. Said about its sound: Recording is crisp and clear, with vocals well balanced and Garcia's playing clearly captured; Reviewer says the sound is great; Cold Rain and Snow fades in; Hard to Handle fades out at 4:31; Dancin' cuts just before its end [1][8][14]
- **gd1970-04-15.sbd.lai.6644.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 13 songs; 77 min; rated 4.33/5 by 12 [3]
- **gd1970-04-15.132734.sbd.reel.latvala-eaton-wise.flac16**: soundboard; 16 songs; 101 min; rated 4.88/5 by 8 [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer rates the show highly relative to other 1970 shows, citing its energy [7]
- Reviewer considers it one of the best shows of 1970 [8]
- Reviewer finds the band tighter and less sloppy than some shows of the era [9]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd70-04-15.sbd.kaplan.14354.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Andy Lemieux and Seth Kaplan; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: This copy supplies four songs missing from earlier circulating versions; reviewer notes a listed CCS-IKYR is absent [5]
- **gd1970-04-15.sbd.lai.6644.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Mike Lai and Wayne Gucwa; source: sdb> Master Reel> Cassette> Dat> CD [3]. Also: Seeded to etree by Mike Lai, with shows supplied by Wayne Gucwa [3]
- **gd1970-04-15.132734.sbd.reel.latvala-eaton-wise.flac16**: taped by Bob Mathews; transferred by Rob Eaton and Jim Wise and Dick Latvala; source: Sony 770 7 Inch Half Track Reel Master @ 7.5 ips-(Bob Mathews); DAT x Zero (DL) > DAT x One (RE) > DAT x Two (JW); play back on a Sony PCM R-500-Digital Audio… [2]

## Art and photos

- Photo by Caine Schneider (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - 4/15/70 Winterland Arena, San Francisco, CA](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/26759946133/) [17]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/26759946133/) [18]
